description.narrative: This allocation contributes to meeting the objectives of the Yemen Humanitarian Response Plan for 2022, which calls for 4.27 billion USD to reach 17.9 million people with humanitarian assistance

This allocation of 38 million DKK to the UN Country-Based Pooled Fund for Yemen contributes to meeting the objectives of the Yemen Humanitarian Response Plan for 2022, which points to 23.4 million people in need and calls for 4.27 billion USD to reach 17.9 million people with humanitarian assistance. The Humanitarian Response Plan aims at reaching 17.5 million people with food security and agricultural assistance; 6.6 million people with nutrition assistance; 12.6 million people with health assistance; 13.1 million people with water, sanitation and hygiene assistance and 11.2 million people with protection including protection of women and girls against gender-based violence.
